downstream.eval_stream: held-out batches, label downstream-eval, seed per run
downstream.probes: multinomial logistic from final-layer hidden states of A2C2 trained and all_local final checkpoints
downstream.reported: per-seed held-out accuracy per property per mode and the trained - all_local gap with seed-level 95% CI
downstream.train_stream: train-split batches, label downstream-train, seed per run

confirmatory_rule.missing_data: at most one retry per run with identical cell identity; a seed missing a pair member is dropped from that setting's paired tests (predeclared, never outcome-based)
confirmatory_rule.pairing: per-seed paired contrast trained vs frozen_random within block pb-p3-{seed}

primary.replicate_if: p < 0.05 AND mean G_R >= 0.01 nats AND mean G_R > 0 at steps 1800/1900/2000 (persistence)

secondary.note: same gates as primary, Bonferroni over 2 secondary settings

cross_setting_pattern.note: descriptive; architectures/corpora are not exchangeable, no pooling

downstream.note: P3 downstream probes (descriptive, not gated): multinomial logistic probes on final-layer hidden states of A2C2 final checkpoints; token-inversion-family privacy scope omission still applies.

probe.init: deterministic, seeded per (run seed, property, mode)

note: Confirmatory external-replication analysis under protocol p3-replication-1.0 (frozen 2026-09-06, fresh seeds [9..89]); per docs/PREREGISTRATION_P3.md. No pooling across settings; privacy not re-evaluated (token-inversion-family scope omission still applies).
